title: AI search optimization: get your business found and cited
seoTitle: AI search optimization: how to get cited
description: AI search optimization in plain steps: how ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews pick sources, and what to fix so your pages get found and cited.
lede: AI search optimization means making your pages easy for ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google's AI Overviews to find, read and quote. Nobody can promise you a spot. This guide explains how these tools choose their sources, then gives you seven practical steps, three prompts and a checklist to fix whatever stands in the way.
keywords: how to show up in ChatGPT
